source.title: Why Biome?
source.description: Whether to choose Biome over separate Prettier and ESLint setups: one package and config, speed benchmarks, editor support, and migration path.

source.title: Comparison with other tools
source.description: Biome versus Prettier, ESLint and Oxc: output compatibility, speed benchmarks, rule naming, plugin limits, type-aware linting and language coverage.

source.title: Language support
source.description: Which languages Biome parses, formats and lints; enabling experimental Vue/Svelte/Astro and embedded CSS/GraphQL, JSONC trailing-comma defaults, and `.gs` Apps Script globals.

source.title: Quick start
source.description: Three-step first run: install with `-E` version pinning, generate `biome.json` via `biome init`, then `biome check --write` to apply fixes.

source.title: Install Biome
source.description: npm/pnpm/yarn/bun/deno with exact-version pinning, or the Node-free standalone binary via install script, Homebrew, Winget, pacman, Docker; upgrading with `biome upgrade` and `biome migrate`.

source.title: Configure Biome
source.description: How `biome.json` is structured and discovered, per-language overrides, `files.includes` globs with `!`/`!!` exclusions, why files are ignored, and which well-known JSON files allow comments.

source.title: Set up your editor
source.description: Install the extension for VS Code, Cursor, Zed or IntelliJ, make Biome the default formatter, wire Helix via `biome lsp-proxy`, and find Neovim, Vim, Emacs and Sublime plugins.

source.title: Integrate with your VCS
source.description: Respect `.gitignore` via `vcs.useIgnoreFile`, and check only changed or staged files with `--changed`, `--since` and `--staged`, e.g. in pre-commit hooks.

source.title: Formatter
source.description: Running `biome format --write`, default formatter options in `biome.json`, shell glob pitfalls, and skipping files or code with `biome-ignore format` comments.

source.title: Differences with Prettier
source.description: Why Biome's output deliberately differs from Prettier's: quoted property keys, parentheses, arrow type-parameter trailing commas, and invalid code left unformatted.

source.title: Formatter Option Philosophy
source.description: Why requests for new formatting options get declined, and why Prettier-compatibility options like `--bracket-same-line` exist only as legacy.

source.title: Suppressions
source.description: Silence lint, assist or plugin diagnostics with `biome-ignore` comments for one line, a range (`biome-ignore-start`/`-end`) or whole file (`biome-ignore-all`); fixes `suppression/unused` errors.

source.title: Linter
source.description: Safe vs unsafe fixes (`--write --unsafe`), rule and group severity, `--only`/`--skip`, domains, rule groups, ESLint migration, and why v2 linting is slow or memory-hungry.

source.title: Domains
source.description: Framework rule groups (React, Vue, Svelte, Next, TanStack Query, tests…) set via `linter.domains`: which dependencies auto-enable each, its rules and globals, and why `project`/`types` slow linting.

source.title: Linter Plugins
source.description: Write custom lint rules as GritQL `.grit` or JavaScript plugins: choosing between them, `register_diagnostic()`, auto-fix rewrites, `includes` scoping, CSS/JSON targets, and the JS semantic model API.

source.title: JavaScript Rules
source.description: Large table to search for any JS/TS/JSX rule's group, purpose and safe/unsafe fix; includes React, Vue, Svelte, Next.js and Playwright rules and recommended-rule default severities.

source.title: Rules sources
source.description: Large lookup table to search: finds the Biome JS/TS lint rule equivalent to an ESLint, typescript-eslint, React, jsx-a11y, unicorn, Jest/Vitest, Vue or other plugin rule when migrating; lists Biome-exclusive rules.

source.title: CSS Rules
source.description: Find which rule flags `!important`, unknown properties, duplicates or specificity issues; shows group, recommended status, fix safety and default severity, not rule options.

source.title: Rules sources
source.description: Maps Stylelint and `@eslint/css` rules to their Biome CSS lint equivalents for migration, and lists Biome-exclusive CSS rules.

source.title: JSON Rules
source.description: Every JSON lint rule by group with fix and recommended status, including `package.json` dependency, license, engines and script checks and Biome config rules.

source.title: Rules sources
source.description: Maps `@eslint/json` and `package.json` ESLint plugin rules to their Biome JSON lint rule equivalents, and lists Biome-only JSON rules.

source.title: HTML Rules
source.description: Lookup table of HTML lint rules by group (a11y, Vue, Svelte, Astro, Tailwind), showing which are recommended, their severity and fix safety.

source.title: Rules sources
source.description: Maps html-eslint, jsx-a11y, Vue, Svelte, Astro and Tailwind plugin rules to their Biome HTML lint equivalents for migration, and lists Biome-exclusive HTML rules.

source.title: Markdown Rules
source.description: The six Markdown lint rules by group: nursery heading-structure, fenced code language and Unicode BOM rules, plus `noEmptySource`; none currently recommended.

source.title: Rules sources
source.description: Maps markdownlint rules (MD001, MD025, MD040, MD041) and `@eslint/markdown` `no-multiple-h1` to their Biome Markdown lint equivalents for migration; `noEmptySource` is Biome-exclusive.

source.title: YAML Rules
source.description: Only three YAML lint rules exist: nursery `noDuplicateMapKeys` and `noYamlBooleanKeys`, plus suspicious `noEmptySource`; none recommended or auto-fixable.

source.title: Rules sources
source.description: Maps eslint-plugin-yml's `no-boolean-key` and `no-empty-document` to Biome YAML lint rules for migration; `noDuplicateMapKeys` is the only Biome-exclusive rule.

source.title: Assist
source.description: How assist actions differ from lint rules, applying them on save via `source.fixAll.biome` code actions, and enforcing or skipping them in `biome check` with `--enforce-assist`.

source.title: JavaScript Actions
source.description: Lists JS/TS assist actions such as `organizeImports` (the only one on by default) and sorting JSX attributes, object keys, enum and interface members, all with safe fixes.

source.title: Actions sources
source.description: Maps ESLint import/key/enum/JSX-prop sorting rules (core, perfectionist, eslint-plugin-import, react, tailwindcss) to equivalent Biome JavaScript assist actions like `organizeImports` and `useSortedKeys`.

source.title: CSS Actions
source.description: Lists assist actions available for CSS files: only `useSortedProperties`, which sorts properties and nested rules with a safe fix.

source.title: Actions sources
source.description: Which CSS assist actions come from other tools: only Biome-exclusive `useSortedProperties` is listed, with no ported actions yet.

source.title: JSON Actions
source.description: Lists the assist actions for JSON files: `useSortedKeys` to sort object keys and `useSortedPackageJson` to order `package.json` fields, both safe fixes.

source.title: Actions sources
source.description: Maps JSON sorting tools to Biome assist actions: `@eslint/json` `sort-keys` to `useSortedKeys`, and `sort-package-json`, Sherif and package-json ESLint plugins to `useSortedPackageJson`.

source.title: HTML Actions
source.description: Assist actions for HTML files: `noDuplicateClasses` removes repeated `class` names and `useSortedAttributes` orders attributes and framework directives, both safe fixes.

source.title: Actions sources
source.description: Maps HTML, Vue, Svelte and Astro attribute-sorting ESLint rules to Biome's HTML `useSortedAttributes` action, and better-tailwindcss `no-duplicate-classes` to `noDuplicateClasses`.

source.title: Markdown Actions
source.description: Confirms Biome currently has no assist actions for Markdown files; the page only has the icon legend and a link for suggesting rules.

source.title: Actions sources
source.description: Which Markdown assist actions come from other tools: currently empty, with no Biome-exclusive or ported Markdown actions listed.

source.title: YAML Actions
source.description: Confirms Biome currently has no assist actions for YAML files; the page only has the icon legend and a link for suggesting rules.

source.title: Actions sources
source.description: Which YAML assist actions come from other tools: currently empty, with no Biome-exclusive or ported YAML actions listed.

source.title: CLI
source.description: Large reference to search, not read: every command's flags, including `--staged`/`--changed`, `--only`/`--skip`, CI `--reporter` formats, formatter overrides, and `BIOME_*` env vars.

source.title: Configuration
source.description: Large reference to search: every `biome.json` option with type and default, plus `extends` nesting, `overrides`, per-language settings and glob syntax like `!!` force-ignore.

source.title: VS Code extension
source.description: Enable format, fix and import sorting on save; every `biome.*` setting, e.g. `biome.lsp.bin` and `inlineConfig`; LSP trace, multi-root workspaces, 2.x migration.

source.title: Zed extension
source.description: Set Biome as per-language formatter in `.zed/settings.json`, fix and organize imports on save, pick the binary, and why global settings break other languages.

source.title: Language server
source.description: For editor-extension authors: supported LSP methods, settings like `configuration_path`, `inline_config` and `go_to_definition`, `lsp-proxy`, `stdin` and daemon integration, and where logs live.

source.title: Continuous Integration
source.description: How `biome ci` differs from `biome check`, with GitHub Actions (`setup-biome`, reviewdog) and GitLab code-quality report examples.

source.title: Git Hooks
source.description: Run Biome on staged files before commit or push with Lefthook, Husky with lint-staged, `pre-commit` hooks, or shell scripts; `--no-errors-on-unmatched` and re-staging fixes.
